primary.title: Memoirs of Louis XIV and the Regency — Complete
primary.author: Louis XIV
primary.rationale: A collection of memoirs attributed to Louis XIV, offering insights into his thoughts and reign. Published posthumously, these are considered primary accounts of his perspective.

primary.title: Lettres de Louis XIV
primary.author: Louis XIV
primary.rationale: A collection of letters written by Louis XIV, providing direct evidence of his correspondence, policies, and personal views. The 1910 edition is a scholarly compilation.

primary.title: Le Testament politique du Cardinal de Richelieu
primary.author: Armand Jean du Plessis Richelieu
primary.rationale: While authored by Richelieu, Louis XIV was heavily influenced by this work and often referred to it. It provides context for the political philosophy that shaped his reign. Louis XIV's own writings often echo Richelieu's ideas.

secondary.title: Louis XIV: The Power and the Folly
secondary.author: Nancy Mitford
secondary.rationale: Although published just before the 1976 cutoff, this is a highly regarded and accessible biography that provides a comprehensive overview of Louis XIV's life and reign.

secondary.title: The Sun King: Louis XIV and the New World
secondary.author: John Brewer
secondary.rationale: A scholarly examination of Louis XIV's reign, focusing on his impact and the broader context of his era, including his influence on the 'New World'.

secondary.title: Louis XIV and the French Monarchy
secondary.author: David Ogg
secondary.rationale: A foundational academic study of Louis XIV and the French monarchy, offering detailed analysis of his political, social, and cultural impact.

suggestions.notes: Primary source materials for Louis XIV are often found in collected works or posthumously published memoirs. Secondary sources are abundant, with many scholarly biographies and analyses available.
